params.hookData: Arbitrary data handed into the PoolManager by the swapper to be be passed on to the hook
params.sender: The initial msg.sender for the swap call

returns._0: bytes4 The function selector for the hook
returns._1: BeforeSwapDelta The hook's delta in specified and unspecified currencies. Positive: the hook is owed/took currency, negative: the hook owes/sent currency
returns._2: uint24 Optionally override the lp fee, only used if three conditions are met: 1. the Pool has a dynamic fee, 2. the value's 2nd highest bit is set (23rd bit, 0x400000), and 3. the value is less than or equal to the maximum fee (1 million)

accruedProtocolRevenue().notice: Protocol take accrued on-chain (ETH) — withdrawn via withdrawProtocolRevenue.

beforeSwap(address,(address,address,uint.notice: The hook called before a swap

consumedThisEpoch().notice: True once any fill consumed active depth this epoch —         blocks mid-epoch re-partitioning via seeds (passive-lock invariant).

depositEth().notice: Deposit ETH for pool shares. Shares are equity — NOT cadence         slots. Re-partitions the λ split only while the epoch's active         depth is untouched (same rule as seeding).

depositedEth(address).notice: Cumulative ETH deposited (gross) — caps withdrawal per spec.

epochCapacityEth(uint256).notice: epoch => active ETH depth snapshot (capacity budget for slots).

epochLengthBlocks().notice: Epoch length in blocks. epochId = block.number / epochLengthBlocks.

lambdaBps().notice: Fraction of total reserves that is ACTIVE each epoch, in bps.

lpPosition(address).notice: Full LP position for the dashboard: deposited, shares, claimable         slot revenue (ETH), claimable swap fees (USDC), withdrawable ETH.

protocolTakeBps().notice: Protocol take of slot proceeds, in bps (default 1000 = 10%).

protocolTreasury().notice: Treasury that withdraws the protocol take (immutable).Treasury that withdraws the protocol take. Rotatable by the         current treasury (production: assign a multisig).

quoteOutUsdc(uint256).notice: Net quote: active-only constant product minus the LP swap fee.         The fee waives while there are no LPs (nothing to accrue to).

refreshEpoch().notice: Re-partition reserves for a new epoch: active = lambda * total.         Permissionless — anyone may refresh (no admin latency).

remainingCapacity().notice: Remaining sellable capacity this epoch: budget - sold.

router().notice: The only router allowed to pass trader identities in hookData.

seedEth().notice: Seed ETH reserves. Re-partitions ONLY while the epoch's active         depth is untouched; once any fill has consumed active depth,         seeds accrue to the next refresh. This keeps the epoch         invariant: a mid-epoch re-partition can never hand back depth         that fills already consumed (repeated dust-seeding cannot         unlock passive reserves).

seedUsdc(uint256).notice: Seed USDC reserves. Same re-partition rule as seedEth.

setProtocolTreasury(address).notice: Rotate the protocol take to a new treasury. Current treasury only.

slotRevenueShareBps().notice: LP share of slot proceeds = 10000 - protocolTakeBps.

soldCapacityEth().notice: Capacity sold this epoch (public mints + live commitments), ETH.

strandedRev(address).notice: Revenue owed but not yet payable (sold-capacity headroom was  exhausted). Survives full withdrawal; pays out once headroom frees.

swapFeeBps().notice: Swap fee on the OUTPUT quote token, in bps (default 30 = 0.30%).

totalEth().notice: Total funded (active + passive + seeds not yet partitioned).

withdrawEth(uint256).notice: Burn shares and withdraw ETH within spec safety bounds:         ethOut = shares * (eligible - soldCapacity) / totalShares,         capped by the LP's still-unwithdrawn deposit value. Accrued         slot revenue and swap fees are paid out in the same call.

withdrawProtocolRevenue(address).notice: Withdraw the accrued protocol take. Only the treasury itself.
